extraFeatureEntry.difference: The owner explicitly requested health and lifespan predictors. New date-limited 2015–2018 official features extend PR23’s identical-input restriction; do not claim strict same-input compliance. Preserve the exact outcomes and cohort, and declare vintage and missing-feature fallback.

longRunEntry: Separate life expectancy in years and GDP per capita in constant-2015 USD: training 1960–1980, origin 1980, test 1981–2025. Use its own cohort, persistence, protocol and missingness rules. Never transform onto Cantril ladder or claim that this validates AI/UBI mechanisms.
freezeGate: Commit all five model pipelines, protocols, calibrations and 700 predictions, plus the long-run protocol and predictions, before ANY new external held-out score. The registry holds immutable commits and SHA-256 hashes. No post-score fitting, reselection or resubmission. Create one exclusive receipt per entry before reading outcomes; retain failed attempts.

honesty.familySelection: Selecting the best of five is exploratory. No independent confirmation, statistical significance or forecast interval is inferred. A genuinely unseen period or cohort is needed for confirmation.
honesty.vintage: Revised 2026 data and model selection after the test period; these are not vintage-correct or blinded 2018 forecasts.
honesty.knownPriorInformation: The published old aggregate failure and proposed structural diagnosis were known. Coordinator research on WHR 2025 definitions unexpectedly surfaced regression tables and 2024 country rankings; no country values were passed to builders or used for model selection. Builders record their own exposure. General post-period literature knowledge cannot be undone.
